label: Shahpur, Starcap, Kurt, Zamora, Bryk, Mayor Scowcroft

people.title: Shahpur
people.look: You meet a haggard woman with long, dark hair. She wears the robes of a priest over her armor, and her garb shows the wear and tear of recent combat.
people.name: _I am Empire War Priestess Shahpur._
people.job: She pats a massive mace hanging at her belt. _I help in the constant battle against the troglos. 'Tis a chore, but I have my faith to preserve me._

nodes.str1: _They're vicious and endless foes, but I'm preserved by my prayers._
nodes.str2: _They're vicious and endless foes. Their numbers have decreased of late, but they still keep coming._

nodes.str1: _I am one of the Anama. I sustain myself through holy power, without using the dark works of magic._
nodes.str2: _I am one of the Anama, as I see you are too. I am glad to see one of my kinfolk so far from the Isle of Bigail! I have advice to give you, if you will accept it._

nodes.str1: _I've heard Mayor Knight of Sharimik was looking for some natural born victims to go on a quest to the castle of the troglos. He's trying to become a bit of a local despot, but the mission may be of interest to you._

people.title: Starcap
people.look: A man, small, wiry, muscular, and leather-clad, is looking you over. His opinion of you seems to be worsening by the moment.
people.name: _I'm Starcap._
people.job: _I spend my life educating cavenewts like you. Fulfilling? I think not._

nodes.str1: _Yeah. Haven't you even been called a suck-weasel before?_ You don't think so.
_How could any job that involves constant work with smelly, unkempt, manners-impaired adventurers be fulfilling?_
_Yeah. Educating cavenewts. Adventurers. Like you._ He gets fed up. _Look, you want training or not?_

people.title: Kurt
people.look: A scruffy looking sailor type is selling tickets by the dock.
people.name: _Kurt._
people.job: _I got tickets to Farport. Fifteen gold. And that's all I have to talk about._
people.dunno: _Look, I'm really happy to be talking to you. Really, really, really happy._

nodes.str1: He peels you off some tickets. _Lovely. Go to the end of this dock, and the boat will be along shortly. Oh, and go away._
nodes.str2: You don't have the cash. Kurt looks at you with disgust.

nodes.str1: _Yeah, right. Look. Everyone else may be willing to spill their guts, their innermost thoughts, to a bunch of wandering, pale, psychotically violent malcontents, but I'm not. Don't want a ticket? Buzz off._

people.title: Zamora
people.look: A dark and mysterious woman sits behind the counter, mixing up a potion. The smells are alternately wonderful and nauseating.
people.name: _I am Zamora,_ she says in a soft voice.
people.job: _I make potions of all sorts. Wondrous things, they are._ She smiles, and tastes the brown concoction she's working on.  _Also, I work with other alchemists._

nodes.str1: She adds a pinch of powder to a bowl of gray green mulch. It bubbles. _These wonders can be yours too. Very useful. Care to purchase one?_

_Why yes._ She smiles. _In fact, one of them was through recently. Told me of some unusual metal he'd found. He concealed a scroll with a map to it, which he told me about. Then he had the misfortune of being spitted by a troglodyte._
nodes.str2: _In fact, for only 500 gold, I may be persuaded to say where the scroll is._

nodes.str1: Zamora's Potions

people.title: Bryk
people.look: This is a heavily whiskered man with a lot of hair growing out of his nose. He smells very strongly of horses.
people.name: _I'm Bryk. That's what they call me!_
people.job: He snorts and takes a pull of whiskey. _I look after horses! They're my babies!_

nodes.str1: He smiles. _I love horses._ Then, worried, he hastens to add _In a healthy, natural way._
_Yeah, nothing better to get quickly from one to town to another than a horse. I even have a bunch of 'em out back, strong and healthy, and for sale._
nodes.str2: _It'd be only 500 gold for horses for your group. Where ya' gonna' get a fairer price than that? Come to me if you ever want to obtain a few._

people.title: Mayor Scowcroft
people.look: The constant attacks of monsters in Valorim have caused the mayors and leaders to have a constant worried and edgy expression. The mayor of Scowcroft is no exception. However, he seems pleased to see you.
people.name: _I'm Mayor Scowcroft. Welcome to you!_
people.job: _Oh, I just try to deal with all the monsters as best I can. I haven't been nearly as effective as your group, though._
people.dunno: He looks nervous. _I can't help. I'm really, really sorry._

nodes.str1: He looks you over, impressed. _Oh, the word of the traveling Exiles has gotten around pretty quick!_ He thinks. _Wait. It isn't a secret you're Exiles, is it? Am I supposed to know?_
He leans close. _I sure don't want to mess around with you, being as you're famous and brave and all. But I'd love to help you if I could._
He leans close. _Be sure to search my bookshelves, and help yourself to anything you find._ He grins conspiratorially.

people.title: Terry
people.look: A wiry man sits cross-legged by the dock, selling tickets.
people.name: _I'm Terry._ He scratches himself.
people.job: _Well, I have tickets for sale. To Fenris Port. Only 10 gold._

nodes.str1: He tears you each off a grimy ticket. _Go to the ends of the docks. I'm sure you'll find a place to use the tickets somewhere._
He laughs, coughs, and spits into the water. _Fenris Port! Great town! Lots of scum there!_
_Yeah!_ He pulls a begging bowl out from behind his back. _Only 5 gold, and I'll give you a little information.

He hawks and spits an impressive, tobacco spotted stream into the water. _The good folks on the Isle of Bigail make certain herbs valuable in Lorelei. Be sure to look about. Also, for only 100 gold more, I'll tell you a secret._

_The guards south of Lorelei will search anyone approaching, looking for these herbs. However, north from Lorelei there's a hidden way to cross the river and get there. Just walk along the river shore. You'll see it._

people.title: Nydia
people.look: You meet a priestess. She's counting several piles of gold on top of the altar. When you approach, she scoops it all into a pouch.
people.name: _I'm Nydia. Welcome._
people.job: _I'm a Priestess of the Church of the Divine Lucre. We sell salvation at reasonable rates._
people.dunno: She looks like you're bothering her.

nodes.str1: _The Church of the Divine Lucre._

_A beautiful organization. After all, the only way to help others is to help oneself. Self-reliance will lift us all up. Wealth is the great salvation. And we grant absolution for very reasonable rates._
_Actually, I am not yet authorized to grant absolution. Haven't saved up enough to buy the ability. But I can do healing, if you wish, and have the money._
Nydia
She looks suspicious. _Who told you to ask me about that?_

She gets upset. You can't imagine why. _Her. I told her I didn't want anything to do ..._ she remembers herself. _Oh. Yes. Look, I'd teach it to you for a fee, but I don't know it. There's a hermit in a hut at the north end of the mountains to the north._
nodes.str2: _ He knows the spell. I can't get it out of him, but you might be able to. Now go away, please._ Highly agitated, she turns away.

people.title: Barber
people.look: Unusually, the innkeeper has a battleaxe swinging at his side, and wears a breastplate which shows the scratches and marks of recent combat. He's so tired he can barely remain standing.
people.name: _Barber,_ he mumbles. _Welcome to my inn._
people.job: _No booze left. Not much at all. Just a room. Only 5 gold. It's been a nightmare._

nodes.str1: Tottering, he shows you to your room. The sounds of combat continuously echo through the town. You sleep poorly.

_Castle Troglo isn't far from here, and there's not a thing anyone can do about it. We eat the worst of the raids, and get hit often, too. It's hard to keep hope sometimes._ He almost nods off several times while speaking.
_I'm afraid this town will fall any day now. I'm so tired. My apologies. This use to to be a beautiful town. No more._
nodes.str2: _The troglos spend most of their time fighting the giants, but send raids against us sometimes still. We still can't rest. Sometimes I think we never will rest again._

people.title: Wounded Person
people.look: A wounded Empire soldier, victim of a troglodyte raider, lies in this bed. All you really see is a mess of bandages and dried blood.
people.name: The victim groans.
people.job: The wounded soldier turns over weakly. It's jarring to see someone so wounded and so unlooked after. There must not be enough magical healing to go around.
